hooks.command: if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then platform=claude; root="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; data="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA"; else platform=codex; root="$PLUGIN_ROOT"; data="$PLUGIN_DATA"; fi; node "$root/scripts/check-update.mjs" --platform "$platform" --root "$root" --data "$data"
hooks.commandWindows: $platform = if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { 'claude' } else { 'codex' }; $root = if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; $data = if ($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA } else { $env:PLUGIN_DATA }; node "$root\scripts\check-update.mjs" --platform $platform --root $root --data $data
